title: Stand Out in a Job Interview | The Harvard Business Review Guide
speaker: Harvard Business Review
zh: 【Harvard Business Review】在求職面試中脫穎而出 |哈佛商業評論指南（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: AMY GALLO: Let's say you've landed a job interview for a position you really want.
cues.en: AMY GALLO: Let's say you've landed a job interview for a position you really want.
cues.zh: 艾米·加洛：假設您已經獲得了您真正想要的職位的面試機會。

cues.text: Well done.
cues.en: Well done.
cues.zh: 幹得好。

cues.text: Congratulations.
cues.en: Congratulations.
cues.zh: 恭喜。

cues.text: But when it's time for the interview, you might get a lot of conflicting advice.
cues.en: But when it's time for the interview, you might get a lot of conflicting advice.
cues.zh: 但到了面試的時候，你可能會得到很多互相矛盾的建議。

cues.text: Be yourself.
cues.en: Be yourself.
cues.zh: 做你自己。

cues.text: Whatever you do, don't be yourself.
cues.en: Whatever you do, don't be yourself.
cues.zh: 無論你做什麼，都不要成為你自己。

cues.text: Take charge of the interview.
cues.en: Take charge of the interview.
cues.zh: 負責面試。

cues.text: Let the interviewer be in charge.
cues.en: Let the interviewer be in charge.
cues.zh: 讓面試官負責。

cues.text: Confusing, right?
cues.en: Confusing, right?
cues.zh: 令人困惑，對吧？

cues.text: Well, I'm here to help.
cues.en: Well, I'm here to help.
cues.zh: 嗯，我是來幫忙的。

cues.text: In this video, I've culled advice from top experts in the field and want
cues.en: In this video, I've culled advice from top experts in the field and want
cues.zh: 在這段影片中，我收集了該領域頂尖專家的建議，並希望

cues.text: to share strategic tips on how best to prepare, what to do,
cues.en: to share strategic tips on how best to prepare, what to do,
cues.zh: 分享有關如何最好地準備、做什麼的策略提示，

cues.text: and what to say so that you can make a great impression in your next interview.
cues.en: and what to say so that you can make a great impression in your next interview.
cues.zh: 以及要說些什麼才能在下次面試中給人留下深刻的印象。

cues.text: [MUSIC PLAYING] First, do your homework.
cues.en: [MUSIC PLAYING] First, do your homework.
cues.zh: [音樂播放] 首先，做你的作業。

cues.text: Let's be honest.
cues.en: Let's be honest.
cues.zh: 說實話。

cues.text: Your primary job in the interview is to dazzle them with the fact that you're perfectly
cues.en: Your primary job in the interview is to dazzle them with the fact that you're perfectly
cues.zh: 你在面試中的首要任務就是讓他們眼花撩亂，讓他們知道你非常完美

cues.text: suited for the role.
cues.en: suited for the role.
cues.zh: 適合這個角色。

cues.text: But before you can do that, you need to invest time in learning about the organization and the job.
cues.en: But before you can do that, you need to invest time in learning about the organization and the job.
cues.zh: 但在此之前，您需要投入時間來瞭解組織和工作。

cues.text: So find out as much as you can about how the organization is structured,
cues.en: So find out as much as you can about how the organization is structured,
cues.zh: 因此，盡可能多地瞭解組織的結構，

cues.text: its culture, and relevant industry trends.
cues.en: its culture, and relevant industry trends.
cues.zh: 其文化以及相關產業趨勢。

cues.text: If possible, see what you can find out about the people conducting the interview.
cues.en: If possible, see what you can find out about the people conducting the interview.
cues.zh: 如果可能的話，看看你能找到關於採訪者的哪些資訊。

cues.text: There may be valuable professional or personal points of connection that could help make your interview more
cues.en: There may be valuable professional or personal points of connection that could help make your interview more
cues.zh: 可能有有價值的專業或個人聯絡點，可以幫助您的面試更加精彩

cues.text: relatable and memorable.
cues.en: relatable and memorable.
cues.zh: 相關且令人難忘。

cues.text: Lastly, research the requirements and challenges of the particular position you're applying for
cues.en: Lastly, research the requirements and challenges of the particular position you're applying for
cues.zh: 最後，研究您所申請的特定職位的要求和挑戰

cues.text: and the qualities of a successful candidate based on that information.
cues.en: and the qualities of a successful candidate based on that information.
cues.zh: 以及基於該資訊的成功候選人的品質。

cues.text: Ask yourself questions like, what technical skills are essential to perform this job?
cues.en: Ask yourself questions like, what technical skills are essential to perform this job?
cues.zh: 問自己這樣的問題：完成這項工作需要哪些技術技能？

cues.text: What kinds of people skills would I need to succeed?
cues.en: What kinds of people skills would I need to succeed?
cues.zh: 我需要具備哪些人際溝通能力才能成功？

cues.text: What do I need to prove I already know how to do or that I'm willing to learn in order to be successful?
cues.en: What do I need to prove I already know how to do or that I'm willing to learn in order to be successful?
cues.zh: 我需要什麼來證明我已經知道該怎麼做或我願意學習才能成功？

cues.text: Being well-prepared will boost your confidence and give you a better chance of acing the interview.
cues.en: Being well-prepared will boost your confidence and give you a better chance of acing the interview.
cues.zh: 做好充分的準備會增強你的信心，讓你更有機會在面試中取得好成績。

cues.text: And all of this information is key to your success in the next tip, crafting your stories.
cues.en: And all of this information is key to your success in the next tip, crafting your stories.
cues.zh: 所有這些資訊都是您在下一個技巧中成功編寫故事的關鍵。

cues.text: That's right.
cues.en: That's right.
cues.zh: 這是正確的。

cues.text: It's story time.
cues.en: It's story time.
cues.zh: 故事時間到了。

cues.text: And these stories are all about why you are the perfect person for the job.
cues.en: And these stories are all about why you are the perfect person for the job.
cues.zh: 這些故事都是關於為什麼你是這份工作的最佳人選。

cues.text: As author Claudio Fernández-Aráoz reminds us, "people buy into stories far more than they do evidence
cues.en: As author Claudio Fernández-Aráoz reminds us, "people buy into stories far more than they do evidence
cues.zh: 正如作家克勞迪奧·費爾南德斯-阿勞斯提醒我們的那樣，“人們對故事的接受程度遠遠超過對證據的接受程度”

cues.text: or data." A good story can also stir up empathy and boost your likability.
cues.en: or data." A good story can also stir up empathy and boost your likability.
cues.zh: 或資料。 」一個好的故事還可以激發同理心並提高你的好感度。

cues.text: If you give them a chance to relate to you as a real person, you might just set yourself apart from the competition.
cues.en: If you give them a chance to relate to you as a real person, you might just set yourself apart from the competition.
cues.zh: 如果你給他們一個機會將你當作一個真實的人來看待，你可能會讓自己在競爭中脫穎而出。

cues.text: Remember how you just researched the skills required for the job and what's important to the organization?
cues.en: Remember how you just researched the skills required for the job and what's important to the organization?
cues.zh: 還記得您剛剛如何研究工作所需的技能以及對組織來說重要的是什麼嗎？

cues.text: Well, now you get to tell powerful personal stories that
cues.en: Well, now you get to tell powerful personal stories that
cues.zh: 好吧，現在你可以講述強而有力的個人故事

cues.text: connect each of those to your own experiences, values, and achievements in both your work and personal life.
cues.en: connect each of those to your own experiences, values, and achievements in both your work and personal life.
cues.zh: 將其中每一個與您自己的工作和個人生活中的經歷、價值觀和成就聯絡起來。

cues.text: Pick three or four main messages you want to convey and craft
cues.en: Pick three or four main messages you want to convey and craft
cues.zh: 選擇您想要傳達和製作的三到四個主要訊息

cues.text: your narratives accordingly.
cues.en: your narratives accordingly.
cues.zh: 相應地你的敘述。

cues.text: The goal is to have these in your back pocket so you can smoothly trot them out
cues.en: The goal is to have these in your back pocket so you can smoothly trot them out
cues.zh: 我們的目標是把它們放在你的後口袋裡，這樣你就可以順利地把它們拿出來

cues.text: as answers to relevant interview questions.
cues.en: as answers to relevant interview questions.
cues.zh: 作為相關面試問題的答案。

cues.text: Author Vicky Oliver writes that a compelling story has a great beginning, riveting middle,
cues.en: Author Vicky Oliver writes that a compelling story has a great beginning, riveting middle,
cues.zh: 作家維姬·奧利佛 (Vicky Oliver) 寫道，一個引人入勝的故事有一個偉大的開頭，引人入勝的中間部分，

cues.text: and an end that makes the interviewer root for you to win the job.
cues.en: and an end that makes the interviewer root for you to win the job.
cues.zh: 以及讓面試官支援你贏得這份工作的結局。

cues.text: Have a good opening line, such as, let me tell you about a time I rescued the organization,
cues.en: Have a good opening line, such as, let me tell you about a time I rescued the organization,
cues.zh: 有一個好的開場白，例如，讓我告訴你我拯救該組織的一次經歷，

cues.text: then tell them about any obstacles or issues that arose and how you overcame them.
cues.en: then tell them about any obstacles or issues that arose and how you overcame them.
cues.zh: 然後告訴他們出現的任何障礙或問題以及您如何克服它們。

cues.text: Keep the story short but interesting and impactful.
cues.en: Keep the story short but interesting and impactful.
cues.zh: 故事要簡短，但有趣且有影響力。

cues.text: An important note-- not all stories have to show total perfection.
cues.en: An important note-- not all stories have to show total perfection.
cues.zh: 重要的一點是──並非所有的故事都必須表現出完美。

cues.text: You will make a real impression and seem more relatable if you can share stories of challenges and even mistakes,
cues.en: You will make a real impression and seem more relatable if you can share stories of challenges and even mistakes,
cues.zh: 如果您能夠分享挑戰甚至錯誤的故事，您會給人留下真實的印象，並且看起來更容易產生共鳴，

cues.text: as long as you remember to show what you learned from them.
cues.en: as long as you remember to show what you learned from them.
cues.zh: 只要你記得展示你從他們身上學到了什麼。

cues.text: Practice, practice-- Once you select your stories, you need to rehearse.
cues.en: Practice, practice-- Once you select your stories, you need to rehearse.
cues.zh: 練習，練習－一旦你選擇了你的故事，你就需要排練。

cues.text: Just like an actor prepares for the stage or screen, you are preparing a character, a confident, competent, likable,
cues.en: Just like an actor prepares for the stage or screen, you are preparing a character, a confident, competent, likable,
cues.zh: 就像演員為舞臺或銀幕做準備一樣，你也在準備一個角色，一個自信、有能力、討人喜歡、

cues.text: flexible version of yourself to perform in the interview.
cues.en: flexible version of yourself to perform in the interview.
cues.zh: 在面試中展現自己的靈活版本。

cues.text: I'm not saying you should be inauthentic or overexaggerate your experiences or skills.
cues.en: I'm not saying you should be inauthentic or overexaggerate your experiences or skills.
cues.zh: 我並不是說你應該不真實或過度誇大你的經驗或技能。

cues.text: But author and coach Cathy Salit writes, "You are literally auditioning for a new role."
cues.en: But author and coach Cathy Salit writes, "You are literally auditioning for a new role."
cues.zh: 但作家兼教練凱西·薩利特寫道：“你實際上是在試鏡一個新角色。”

cues.text: You are presenting the best possible version of yourself.
cues.en: You are presenting the best possible version of yourself.
cues.zh: 您正在展示自己最好的版本。

cues.text: And since you've done your homework, you know what parts of your personality and experience
cues.en: And since you've done your homework, you know what parts of your personality and experience
cues.zh: 既然你已經做了功課，你就知道你的個性和經歷的哪些部分

cues.text: to emphasize for each position.
cues.en: to emphasize for each position.
cues.zh: 強調每個位置。

cues.text: So what exactly should you practice?
cues.en: So what exactly should you practice?
cues.zh: 那麼具體該練習什麼呢？

cues.text: Well, for one, practice your opening.
cues.en: Well, for one, practice your opening.
cues.zh: 嗯，一方面，練習你的開場白。

cues.text: First impressions really matter here.
cues.en: First impressions really matter here.
cues.zh: 第一印像在這裡真的很重要。

cues.text: In fact, research shows that people form opinions about your personality and intelligence
cues.en: In fact, research shows that people form opinions about your personality and intelligence
cues.zh: 事實上，研究顯示人們會對你的個性和智力形成看法

cues.text: in the first 30 seconds of the interview, 30 seconds.
cues.en: in the first 30 seconds of the interview, 30 seconds.
cues.zh: 訪談的前30秒，30秒。

cues.text: So in front of a mirror, pretend you are introducing yourself and assess things like your posture, tone,
cues.en: So in front of a mirror, pretend you are introducing yourself and assess things like your posture, tone,
cues.zh: 因此，在鏡子前，假裝您正在自我介紹，並評估您的姿勢、語氣、

cues.text: and body language.
cues.en: and body language.
cues.zh: 和肢體語言。

cues.text: You want to communicate a balance of ease, clarity, and confidence.
cues.en: You want to communicate a balance of ease, clarity, and confidence.
cues.zh: 您希望傳達輕鬆、清晰和自信的平衡。

cues.text: The most important thing is to practice telling your stories with energy and enthusiasm.
cues.en: The most important thing is to practice telling your stories with energy and enthusiasm.
cues.zh: 最重要的是練習充滿活力和熱情地講述你的故事。

cues.text: You want to be ready to share them as confident, clear, and straightforward responses to relevant interview questions.
cues.en: You want to be ready to share them as confident, clear, and straightforward responses to relevant interview questions.
cues.zh: 您希望準備好將它們作為對相關面試問題的自信、清晰和直接的回答來分享。

cues.text: You can even practice in front of a friend or record yourself on video.
cues.en: You can even practice in front of a friend or record yourself on video.
cues.zh: 您甚至可以在朋友面前練習或將自己錄製成影片。

cues.text: You can then use the feedback to make any necessary adjustments to your appearance or your delivery
cues.en: You can then use the feedback to make any necessary adjustments to your appearance or your delivery

cues.text: before the actual interview.
cues.en: before the actual interview.
cues.zh: 在實際面試之前。

cues.text: Have a great conversation.
cues.en: Have a great conversation.
cues.zh: 愉快地交談。

cues.text: Once you're comfortable telling your stories, Cathy Salit has another unique piece of advice.
cues.en: Once you're comfortable telling your stories, Cathy Salit has another unique piece of advice.
cues.zh: 一旦您能夠輕鬆地講述自己的故事，Cathy Salit 就會給出另一個獨特的建議。

cues.text: Instead of performing as someone who is trying really hard to get the job, perform as someone who wants to have
cues.en: Instead of performing as someone who is trying really hard to get the job, perform as someone who wants to have
cues.zh: 不要表現得像一個非常努力地想要得到這份工作的人，而要表現得像一個想要得到這份工作的人

cues.text: a great conversation with the person across from you.
cues.en: a great conversation with the person across from you.
cues.zh: 與你對面的人進行一次愉快的交談。

cues.text: First, be curious or at least perform curiosity
cues.en: First, be curious or at least perform curiosity
cues.zh: 首先，保持好奇心或至少表現出好奇心

cues.text: if you need to.
cues.en: if you need to.
cues.zh: 如果你需要的話。

cues.text: Ask open-ended questions connected to what you've heard.
cues.en: Ask open-ended questions connected to what you've heard.
cues.zh: 提出與您所聽到的內容相關的開放式問題。

cues.text: This will allow the conversation to unfold more naturally.
cues.en: This will allow the conversation to unfold more naturally.
cues.zh: 這將使對話更加自然地展開。

cues.text: Side note, if you need some ideas, check out the links for another HBR video on 38 smart questions
cues.en: Side note, if you need some ideas, check out the links for another HBR video on 38 smart questions

cues.text: to ask in an interview.
cues.en: to ask in an interview.
cues.zh: 在訪談中詢問。

cues.text: Be ready to improvise.
cues.en: Be ready to improvise.
cues.zh: 準備好即興發揮。

cues.text: I know I've just told you to prepare and rehearse your stories, but they aren't just talking points
cues.en: I know I've just told you to prepare and rehearse your stories, but they aren't just talking points
cues.zh: 我知道我剛剛告訴你要準備並排練你的故事，但它們不僅僅是談話要點

cues.text: to be rattled off.
cues.en: to be rattled off.
cues.zh: 被喋喋不休。

cues.text: You also need to listen attentively and be ready to accept every conversational opening with the classic improv
cues.en: You also need to listen attentively and be ready to accept every conversational opening with the classic improv
cues.zh: 您還需要專心聆聽，並準備好接受每個對話開頭以及經典的即興表演

cues.text: phrase, "yes, and" as a way to build upon the conversation.
cues.en: phrase, "yes, and" as a way to build upon the conversation.
cues.zh: 短語“是的，並且”作為對話的一種方式。

cues.text: Also, as author John Lees reminds us, be flexible, read the room, and adjust accordingly.
cues.en: Also, as author John Lees reminds us, be flexible, read the room, and adjust accordingly.
cues.zh: 此外，正如作者約翰·利斯（John Lees）提醒我們的那樣，要靈活，閱讀房間，並做出相應的調整。

cues.text: If your radar is telling you that your stories aren't working, you may need to supply different answers,
cues.en: If your radar is telling you that your stories aren't working, you may need to supply different answers,
cues.zh: 如果你的雷達告訴你你的故事不起作用，你可能需要提供不同的答案，

cues.text: adjust your tone, or stop speaking altogether because, well, some interviewers just love
cues.en: adjust your tone, or stop speaking altogether because, well, some interviewers just love
cues.zh: 調整你的語氣，或乾脆停止說話，因為有些面試官就是喜歡

cues.text: to hear themselves talk.
cues.en: to hear themselves talk.
cues.zh: 聽自己說話。

cues.text: Pay attention and change course as needed.
cues.en: Pay attention and change course as needed.
cues.zh: 注意並根據需要改變路線。

cues.text: When things go wrong-- despite your best efforts to prepare,
cues.en: When things go wrong-- despite your best efforts to prepare,
cues.zh: 當事情出錯時——儘管你盡了最大努力做好準備，

cues.text: interviews don't always go as planned.
cues.en: interviews don't always go as planned.
cues.zh: 面試並不總是按計劃進行。

cues.text: Here are some potential pitfalls and what you can do about them.
cues.en: Here are some potential pitfalls and what you can do about them.
cues.zh: 以下是一些潛在的陷阱以及您可以採取的措施。

cues.text: Lack of direct experience-- If there are areas where your past achievements don't directly
cues.en: Lack of direct experience-- If there are areas where your past achievements don't directly
cues.zh: 缺乏直接經驗－如果有些領域與你過去的成就不直接相關

cues.text: correlate to the job, redirect the focus away from where your experience might
cues.en: correlate to the job, redirect the focus away from where your experience might
cues.zh: 與工作相關，將注意力從你的經驗可能的地方轉移開

cues.text: fall short and towards an emphasis on your potential and overall competence.
cues.en: fall short and towards an emphasis on your potential and overall competence.
cues.zh: 不足並強調您的潛力和整體能力。

cues.text: If you can demonstrate your ability to learn a skill or adapt to a situation, this could convince an interviewer
cues.en: If you can demonstrate your ability to learn a skill or adapt to a situation, this could convince an interviewer
cues.zh: 如果您能夠展現自己學習技能或適應情況的能力，這可以說服面試官

cues.text: to ignore any potential holes in your CV.
cues.en: to ignore any potential holes in your CV.
cues.zh: 忽略履歷中任何潛在的漏洞。

cues.text: One side note-- taking charge of the interview in this way can help steer interviewers away from unconscious biases
cues.en: One side note-- taking charge of the interview in this way can help steer interviewers away from unconscious biases

cues.text: that favor experience over competence.
cues.en: that favor experience over competence.
cues.zh: 優先考慮經驗而不是能力。

cues.text: Tough questions about your resume-- If there are some less-than-perfect situations
cues.en: Tough questions about your resume-- If there are some less-than-perfect situations
cues.zh: 關於你的履歷的棘手問題——如果有一些不太完美的情況

cues.text: on your CV, like a long pause in your work history or a short stay at a recent job, John Lees
cues.en: on your CV, like a long pause in your work history or a short stay at a recent job, John Lees
cues.zh: 在你的履歷中，例如你的工作經驗中的長時間停頓或在最近的工作中短暫停留，John Lees

cues.text: recommends preparing multiple ways to reply so that you aren't left struggling for an answer.
cues.en: recommends preparing multiple ways to reply so that you aren't left struggling for an answer.
cues.zh: 建議準備多種回覆方式，這樣您就不會苦苦尋找答案。

cues.text: First, prepare a simple, straightforward response that doesn't go into too much detail.
cues.en: First, prepare a simple, straightforward response that doesn't go into too much detail.
cues.zh: 首先，準備一個簡單、直接的答覆，不要涉及太多細節。

cues.text: Then have an additional reply ready if the interviewer follows up.
cues.en: Then have an additional reply ready if the interviewer follows up.
cues.zh: 如果面試官跟進，請準備好額外的答案。

cues.text: For example, if you didn't finish a degree that would have been helpful to the job,
cues.en: For example, if you didn't finish a degree that would have been helpful to the job,
cues.zh: 例如，如果你沒有完成對工作有幫助的學位，

cues.text: be ready to answer an initial question with something like, I felt it was better to go straight into the workforce.
cues.en: be ready to answer an initial question with something like, I felt it was better to go straight into the workforce.
cues.zh: 準備好回答最初的問題，例如「我覺得最好直接進入勞動市場」。

cues.text: If the interviewer pushes further, be ready with another level of detail, such as I
cues.en: If the interviewer pushes further, be ready with another level of detail, such as I
cues.zh: 如果面試官進一步提出要求，請準備好另一個層次的細節，例如我

cues.text: thought about it carefully.
cues.en: thought about it carefully.
cues.zh: 仔細想了一下。

cues.text: I knew it would carry negative connotations, but I was confident that I would learn a lot more
cues.en: I knew it would carry negative connotations, but I was confident that I would learn a lot more
cues.zh: 我知道它會帶有負面意義，但我有信心我會學到更多

cues.text: with direct work experience.
cues.en: with direct work experience.
cues.zh: 具有直接工作經驗。

cues.text: Mistakes happen.
cues.en: Mistakes happen.
cues.zh: 錯誤會發生。

cues.text: If you notice your interviewer losing interest or you've stumbled over some answers,
cues.en: If you notice your interviewer losing interest or you've stumbled over some answers,
cues.zh: 如果您發現面試官失去了興趣或您偶然發現了一些答案，

cues.text: don't dwell on the mistakes.
cues.en: don't dwell on the mistakes.
cues.zh: 不要糾纏於錯誤。

cues.text: Just keep going and stay focused.
cues.en: Just keep going and stay focused.
cues.zh: 繼續前進並保持專注。

cues.text: Answer the current question as if it's the first one.
cues.en: Answer the current question as if it's the first one.
cues.zh: 像回答第一個問題一樣回答當前問題。

cues.text: Even acknowledging the situation with a corrective statement like, am I giving you what you need,
cues.en: Even acknowledging the situation with a corrective statement like, am I giving you what you need,
cues.zh: 即使透過糾正性宣告來承認這種情況，例如，我是否給了你你需要的東西，

cues.text: is there other information I could give you, and then following their cues can help dig you out
cues.en: is there other information I could give you, and then following their cues can help dig you out
cues.zh: 我可以向您提供其他資訊嗎？然後按照他們的提示可以幫助您找到答案

cues.text: of the current hole and get the conversation back on track.
cues.en: of the current hole and get the conversation back on track.
cues.zh: 當前的漏洞並使對話回到正軌。

cues.text: A note on preparing virtual interviews-- Many interviews these days take place virtually.
cues.en: A note on preparing virtual interviews-- Many interviews these days take place virtually.
cues.zh: 關於準備虛擬面試的注意事項—如今許多面試都是虛擬進行的。

cues.text: If that's the case for you, here are some specific things you should do to prepare.
cues.en: If that's the case for you, here are some specific things you should do to prepare.
cues.zh: 如果您屬於這種情況，那麼您應該做以下一些具體準備。

cues.text: First, prepare your space.
cues.en: First, prepare your space.
cues.zh: 首先，準備好你的空間。

cues.text: You want your background to be clean and uncluttered.
cues.en: You want your background to be clean and uncluttered.
cues.zh: 您希望您的背景乾淨整潔。

cues.text: Clean up the area around you, too, even if it's not visible on camera.
cues.en: Clean up the area around you, too, even if it's not visible on camera.
cues.zh: 即使在相機上看不到，也要清理周圍的區域。

cues.text: Research shows that when our space is messy, so is our thinking.
cues.en: Research shows that when our space is messy, so is our thinking.
cues.zh: 研究表明，當我們的空間混亂時，我們的思維也會混亂。

cues.text: A clean environment will boost your mood and make you feel less stressed.
cues.en: A clean environment will boost your mood and make you feel less stressed.
cues.zh: 乾淨的環境會提振你的心情，減輕你的壓力。

cues.text: These are things your interviewer can see, and it will make a big difference in your performance.
cues.en: These are things your interviewer can see, and it will make a big difference in your performance.
cues.zh: 這些是你的面試官可以看到的東西，這將對你的表現產生很大的影響。

cues.text: Your face should be well lit and visible.
cues.en: Your face should be well lit and visible.
cues.zh: 您的臉應該光線充足且清晰可見。

cues.text: Make sure your internet speed is in good shape.
cues.en: Make sure your internet speed is in good shape.
cues.zh: 確保您的網路速度良好。

cues.text: Pro tip, Google internet speed test and check to make sure the Wi-Fi you are using
cues.en: Pro tip, Google internet speed test and check to make sure the Wi-Fi you are using
cues.zh: 專業提示，Google 網路速度測試並檢查以確保您正在使用的 Wi-Fi

cues.text: can handle the call.
cues.en: can handle the call.
cues.zh: 可以處理呼叫。

cues.text: Next, prepare yourself.
cues.en: Next, prepare yourself.
cues.zh: 接下來，做好準備。

cues.text: Even though it's virtual, you should dress for the interview.
cues.en: Even though it's virtual, you should dress for the interview.
cues.zh: 儘管是虛擬的，但您還是應該穿著參加面試。

cues.text: Unless the organization is an all-suit situation, experts recommend a business casual outfit in neutral colors
cues.en: Unless the organization is an all-suit situation, experts recommend a business casual outfit in neutral colors
cues.zh: 除非組織是全西裝場合，否則專家建議穿著中性色調的商務休閒服裝

cues.text: to appear more authentic, trustworthy, creative, and knowledgeable.
cues.en: to appear more authentic, trustworthy, creative, and knowledgeable.
cues.zh: 顯得更加真實、值得信賴、富有創造力和知識淵博。

cues.text: Wear something comfortable.
cues.en: Wear something comfortable.
cues.zh: 穿一些舒服的衣服。

cues.text: You don't want to be fidgeting with your clothes while on camera.
cues.en: You don't want to be fidgeting with your clothes while on camera.
cues.zh: 您不想在鏡頭前擺弄自己的衣服。

cues.text: Use your computer's camera to check yourself and your space ahead of time so you
cues.en: Use your computer's camera to check yourself and your space ahead of time so you
cues.zh: 使用電腦的攝影機提前檢查您自己和您的空間，以便您

cues.text: can see what your interviewers will see and make any necessary tweaks.
cues.en: can see what your interviewers will see and make any necessary tweaks.
cues.zh: 可以看到面試官會看到什麼並做出必要的調整。

cues.text: OK, let's review.
cues.en: OK, let's review.
cues.zh: 好的，我們回顧一下。

cues.text: Here's a quick wrap-up of the do's and don'ts so you can stand out in your next interview.
cues.en: Here's a quick wrap-up of the do's and don'ts so you can stand out in your next interview.
cues.zh: 以下是該做什麼和不該做什麼的快速總結，以便您可以在下次面試中脫穎而出。

cues.text: All of these strategies are based on articles linked in the description.
cues.en: All of these strategies are based on articles linked in the description.
cues.zh: 所有這些策略都基於描述中連結的文章。

cues.text: Do you have any advice on how to stand out in an interview?
cues.en: Do you have any advice on how to stand out in an interview?
cues.zh: 您對如何在面試中脫穎而出有什麼建議嗎？

cues.text: Or do you have other big topics you'd like me to cover?
cues.en: Or do you have other big topics you'd like me to cover?
cues.zh: 或是您有其他重要主題希望我介紹嗎？

cues.text: Comment below.
cues.en: Comment below.
cues.zh: 請在下面評論。

cues.text: Bye for now.
cues.en: Bye for now.
cues.zh: 暫時再見。
